127488.overview:
Black Knight 2000 is a 1989 pinball game designed by Steve Ritchie (who also provides the Knight's voice) and released by Williams Electronics. The game is the sequel to the 1980 pinball machine Black Knight.

The Black Knight returns, this time in a techno-feudal landscape (eschewing the more traditional, ornate look of the previous game). The player must storm the Knight's castle and battle him, while a Choir of Angels provide moral support for the player. It was the first pinball game to offer a Wizard Mode, and featured a truly memorable soundtrack with Chicago singers Stephanie Rogers and Glo Van Vlack.

177963.overview:
Banzai Run is a pinball table designed by Pat Lawlor and Larry DeMar, with artwork by Mark Sprenger. It was released in 1988 by Williams Electronics, and is notable for its continuous playfield, which extends vertically into the backbox.

The game itself is centered on the 1988 Banzai Run Supercross race on the notorious Banzai Hill track. As an up-and-coming racer, you are up against four rivals: Green Machine, Yellow Belly, Blue Beard, and Red Hot. Build up laps on the lower playfield, then hit the twelve color-coded targets to challenge each racer and access the hill. Once that's done, ride the Ball Lifter to the vertical playfield to defeat the challengers, then take on the King of the Hill in a light-and-sound spectacular.

196002.overview:
Catch the wave with Beach Bums, an original pinball table released in 2018. This table transports players to a sun-soaked beach paradise. Featuring colorful artwork, a groovy soundtrack, and engaging gameplay, it offers a laid-back yet exciting pinball experience. The table includes a surfboard ramp, a tiki hut kicker, and a Big Kahuna multiball mode, all set against a backdrop of crashing waves and palm trees. Whether you're a seasoned player or a casual enthusiast, Beach Bums delivers a fun-filled ride on the gnarliest waves.

Beach Bums began life as an attempt by watacaractr to refurbish and re-theme his "Roy Clark, The Entertainer" real physical pinball table. The theme was based upon his favourite slot machine, IGT's "Catch-A-Wave". Unfotunately, after re-theming it, and putting it back together, the pinball table no longer worked.

Undeterred, watacaractr took his original artwork and theme ideas and used them to create his first digital table for Visual Pinball X, by modding BordDog's version of Hollywood Heat (Gottlieb 1986).

208971.overview: Bob's Burgers is one of four tables in the Balls of Glory table pack, based on animated Fox TV sitcoms. Released in the fall of 2015 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3, this table showcases the daily activities of the Belcher family, proud managers of the titular Bob's Burgers restaurant.

208984.overview: Blade is one of the first four Marvel pinball tables released in 2010 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. It is based on the superhero vampire hunter of the same name, who is a human-vampire hybrid with powerful weapons and abilities, collaborating with the supernatural detective Hannibal King to hunt and eventually bring down Marvel's version of the famous vampire Dracula.

216510.overview: Biolab is a pinball table that was released with the launch of Pinball FX2 as part of the Core Collection, and was re-released in all subsequent Pinball FX games; it was also made available for Zen Pinball Party in February 2022. The table depicts the crazy ongoings in a science lab that ensue when a mad scientist genetically engineers new creatures in hopes of designing what he believes to be the "perfect organism".

461859.overview: Big Flush is a rare pinball machine released in 1983 by the Brazilian manufacturer LTD do Brasil. It is primarily known today in the digital pinball community, with recreations available for platforms like Visual Pinball X (VPX).

468066.overview:
Back to the Future is one of three tables in the Universal Pictures Classics mini table pack, released in 2017 and available for Pinball FX 3 and the macOS version of Zen Pinball 2. It is based on all three installments of the Back to the Future trilogy, directed by Robert Zemeckis. The pinball machine chronicles the events of the film trilogy, depicting the time-traveling adventures of teenager Marty McFly and Dr. Emmett L. Brown, who invented a groundbreaking time-traveling machine in the form of a heavily modified DeLorean.

This is the second pinball adaptation of the Back to the Future film trilogy, with the first being Data East's Back to the Future: The Pinball, released shortly after the third film in 1990. Unlike the Data East machine, this Pinball FX table does not include any music or voices from the original movies.

The objective of the table is to relive the events of the Back to the Future trilogy, journeying through various times and locations using the DeLorean.

The player will always be in a particular time period while playing this table, and before the first ball is launched, the player must decide which of the six time periods to visit first with the time machine. Once a time period is chosen, the player stays in that setting until its missions are completed successfully or all balls are lost, meaning that it is not possible to fail a mission and no progress is lost when a ball is drained. After all tasks in a time period are completed, the player must shoot the flux capacitor through either of its two entry ramps to choose the next time setting (or start the wizard mode once all periods are completed).

Each time period is split into two parts. The first half involves completing three tasks, which are each completed by hitting certain targets or lanes. Each task is further split into two phases: the mission phase where the shots have to be made, and a time-limited bonus phase that provides an opportunity to earn more points (which will end prematurely if the ball is drained). Once the timers for all three bonus phases have expired, the second half of the time period is a "finale" where the player is tasked with one final mission to escape the current time period.

The timers for the bonus phases of each mission can be increased from 15 seconds by 5 seconds (to a maximum of 60 seconds) by spelling "TIME" at the standup targets. The timers reset at the end of each ball. 

Tips:

This table offers a few extra balls that you can earn, so make every effort to earn them so that you can survive all 6 missions and make it to the wizard mode. Shooting the right orbit frequently with varying force can eventually lead to two extra balls if you are diligent enough.

Be considerate of when you want to activate multiball modes if you want to get through all missions faster because multiball modes will block you from going to the next time setting until they end once the current mission is finished.

468644.overview:
Stick close to your brothers as you complete missions and liberate towns within the Netherlands – now armed with a silver ball and your skills. Help SSgt Matthew Baker and the 101st Airborne in day and nighttime missions and claim your place on the leaderboards.

Features:
- Command your squad in exciting day and nighttime missions
- Shoot only lit lanes to move your squad in stealth in Infiltration mode
- Spell RECON and complete the Hurry-Up to score more points in the main modes
- Destroy Flak 88 cannons and repair the bridge with successful shots
- Liberate 4 cities to reach Win the War Wizard mode, and get millions of points in a 5-ball multiball

Brothers In Arms is included in the Gearbox Pinball pack, released alongside the official launch of the Pinball FX reboot.

468645.overview:
Welcome, Vault Hunter, to a pinball game of looting and jackpot shooting! Armed with your trusty silver balls, face down fearsome psychos, skags, and bosses as you fight your way across Pandora!

- Level up, minion! Shoot the spinning target and earn points to increase your pinball prowess!
- Catch-a-Riiiiiiideee! Shoot the spindisk and goooooooo!
- Poking a Skag never hurt anyone! Play right and he'll reward you.
- Congratulations, you've found the Vault! Now all you have to do is survive the Boss and the loot is yours. Try not to die!
- Oh, you did die. No problem! Save your ball with precise shots and you'll be a whole New-U!

Borderlands is one of the three tables included in the Gearbox Pinball pack, released alongside the official launch of the Pinball FX reboot. Taking influence from early 90s Williams tables, the primary goal of the table is to start Boss Fight Multiball four times, scoring a super jackpot during each boss fight to complete them, for a chance at lucrative scoring during the fight against Tyreen Calypso.

468648.overview:
Take control of the Battlestar Galactica and keep humanity one step ahead of the Cylon threat. Keep them at bay by fighting space battles and resisting subterfuge. You must keep everyone alive and reach the final goal: Earth. So say we all.

Released as part of the Universal Pinball: TV Classics pack for Pinball FX on 16 May 2024.

469305.overview:
Sharpen your reflexes! Crisper action, tighter hits and dojo redesign breathe new life into the martial arts table.

Blackbelt 2018 is a digital reimagining of the classic 1986 solid-state table, developed by Magic Pixel for Zaccaria Pinball.

469414.overview:
Step into the ring! Punchy combos, boxing bell sounds, and fast-paced action pack this table with knockout excitement.

Boxing Club is a digital pinball table first released as part of A.S.K. Homework's "Age of Pinballs Pro" iOS game in 2013. The developer later ported the table to Zaccaria Pinball as an 'award' table in 2025.

470423.overview:
Master the dojo in deluxe style! Smooth moves, crisp hits, and vibrant visuals make martial arts action shine.

Blackbelt Deluxe is a modern reimagining of Zaccaria's classic Blackbelt pinball table from 1986, blending fast-paced martial arts action with cutting-edge pinball mechanics. Battle your way through 9 thrilling modes and 5 side missions as you train to become the ultimate martial arts master. Strike targets with precision, execute skillful combos, and unleash powerful multiball sequences to prove your mastery. 

With classic ramps, interactive elements, and a dojo-inspired playfield, Blackbelt Deluxe challenges players to test their reflexes and discipline in the ultimate pinball showdown!

470583.overview:
The Beastie Boys were an American hip hop and rap rock group formed in New York City in 1979. They were composed of Adam "Ad-Rock" Horovitz (vocals, guitar), Adam "MCA" Yauch (vocals, bass), and Michael "Mike D" Diamond (vocals, drums).

This homebrew table is a mod of Williams' 1981 table "Barracora" for Visual Pinball X. It includes 38 songs from the band that can be cycled through whilst playing, using the right magna save button.

471286.overview:
Bubble Bobble is a popular original table for Future Pinball, first released in 2006 by creator Ruckage. It is celebrated for its colorful, faithful recreation of the Taito arcade classic, even embedding a functional mini-video game directly onto the playfield.

The table challenges players to manage traditional pinball physics while simultaneously playing the video sub-game. Hit targets and triggers on the table to make bubbles drop on the playfield. You move the character Bob using the flipper keys to catch these falling bubbles for points. Bubbles at the edge of the screen move faster but are worth more points. Points can still be collected from falling bubbles even after a ball is lost.

471354.overview:
Billion Dollar Gameshow is a virtual pinball table known for its flashy TV quiz show theme and exceptionally high scoring potential, including a one billion point award. The table focuses on winning "prizes" through specific ramp and target combinations to build toward a massive jackpot. Players need to collect six high-value prizes (TV, Trip, Car, House, Boat, Plane) to light the Billion Dollar Award.

It is one of four tables available in 21st Century Entertainment's renowned video game, Pinball Fantasies. First released for the Commodore Amiga in 1992, the game was later ported to a variety of other platforms, including Atari Jaguar (1995), SNES (1995), Nintendo Game Boy (1995), Sony Playstation (1996), and iOS (2009).

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by users Sebek74, Slash2084, & Jerry Winter for Future Pinball in 2006.

471359.overview:
Blue vs Pink is an original virtual table designed by Brendan Bailey and later updated by TerryRed for the Future Pinball platform. The table features a vibrant, neon-heavy design that pits a blue-themed side against a pink-themed side, each with its own scoring tally. Players must avoid the blue or pink targets, respectively, at all costs after each opposing lane change.

It is considered a stand-out table for Future Pinball, and is notably highlighted in the AtGames Legends "Pinball in the Clouds" recommendations list of Pinball AddOnX (pAOX) games that support both Team Play and Party Play.

471580.overview:
Blade Runner is a 1982 science fiction film directed by Ridley Scott from a screenplay by Hampton Fancher and David Peoples. Starring Harrison Ford, Rutger Hauer, Sean Young, and Edward James Olmos, it is an adaptation of Philip K. Dick's 1968 novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? The film is set in a dystopian future Los Angeles of 2019, in which synthetic humans known as replicants are bio-engineered by the powerful Tyrell Corporation to work on space colonies. When a fugitive group of advanced replicants led by Roy Batty (Hauer) escapes back to Earth, former cop Rick Deckard (Ford) reluctantly agrees to hunt them down.

Blade Runner: Replicant Edition is TerryRed's mod of SLAMT1LT's original Blade Runner: ULTIMATE Pro table for Future Pinball. It has been overhauled and modernized with FizX physics, new art, gameplay fixes, and new features.

471637.overview:
Beat Box is a notable table featured in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions for the Amiga and later ported to various platforms. The table revolves around the theme of managing a struggling pop band, with objectives designed to help them achieve success. Gameplay involves advancing the band's career by securing deals, booking tours, and moving them up the charts.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by users Slash2084 and Sebek74.

471818.overview: Though the playfield shares some similarites in layout to Date East's physical table from 1990, over the years SLAMT1LT has evolved this into a completely new table. Starting work in 2010, his ULTIMATE Pro Edition from 2020 includes different game modes, clips from the movie, new artwork and sounds, and much, much more.

471911.overview: Created by SLAMT1LT for Future Pinball, this table is a celebration of the 50th anniversary of the Bond film franchise.

472160.overview: Marty02's Visual Pinball X mod of Data East's 1990 table makes a number of changes, including different artwork, slightly modified rules and lighting changes. It also has PUP pack compatibility for video support, and the option of using alt sound.

472259.overview:
Big Spender Pinball is a popular, original virtual pinball table created for Future Pinball by PolyGame around 2008. The table is heavily themed around gambling and casino games. Unlike traditional pinball where you only score points, in Big Spender, players can lose points just as quickly as they gain them. The gameplay centers on challenging "the Banker," where players must win bets on various casino games around the playfield to stay ahead of the banker each round, or face an abrupt game over.

The game has received a number of updates over the years by different users, notably SLAMT1LT's "Big Spender Pinball: ULTRA Edition", and Lacarril's "Big Spender Pinball 2000".

473371.overview:
Big Guns is a medieval space themed pinball machine from October 1987, manufactured by Williams Electronic Games, Inc. It is best known for being the first table to feature catapults, though due to the plastic covers that house them, they resemble cannons.

The table was recreated for Future Pinball by ROM, D Struct, and Francisco666, and then modded by SLAMT1LT who released both ULTRA and ULTIMATE editions. Unlike many other SLAMT1LT releases, Big Guns remains very true to the original machine and adds little in the way of obvious enhancements, other than small tweaks to the Future Pinball physics, mechanical sounds, and scripting.

An updated version of SLAMT1LT's ULTIMATE Edition was released by NitroNimbus under the title of MOD 2.0, and this adjusts the physics, adds a DMD, and plays "War" by Edwin Starr during gameplay. 

A lot of the assets from this table were used by 32assassin for his Visual Pinball X recreation of Big Guns.

473620.overview: A Future Pinball mod of SLAMT1LT's version of Gorgar, based upon the 1965 French television miniseries about a mysterious phantom that appears in the Louvre Museum in Paris at night.

476147.overview: Multi-platinum, Grammy Award-winning pop icon Britney Spears is one of the most successful and celebrated entertainers in pop history with over 100 million records sold worldwide. In the U.S. alone, she has sold more than 70 million albums, singles and songs and now there's a Visual Pinball X table in her honour. This table is a mod of Gottlieb's "Diamond Lady".

477259.overview:
Step into the rhythm and chaos of Chicago's coolest caper with this fully loaded, music-driven, fast-paced pinball experience! Whether you're a fan of the movie or a die-hard pinball wizard, this machine will leave you shaking your tail feather.

Released for both Future Pinball and Visual Pinball X, the Blues Brothers is an original table by Marty02 with a playfield layout based upon Stern's 1980 Seawitch.

480910.overview:
An original table for Future Pinball inspired by the 1969 British war movie starring Laurence Olivier and Michael Caine. The objective of the game is to complete missions, receive medals and shoot down fighters and bombers. "Kills" are achieved by completing banks of targets on the upper level playfields.
 
The first upper level, via the ramp, offers the opportunity to destroy "Fighters". There are two banks of three targets either side of the "V-Turn" which require all three targets to be lit to confirm a "kill". Damage is recorded and a Bonus is accrued for every hit on a target (providing you have ammunition) even if the target is already lit. The second upper level via the "V-Turn" offers the "Bombers" targets, a single bank of five.

Game Rules:
--------------

HEADQUARTERS: HQ kicker hole marked by British flag. Accept missions and receive awards
	
AIR RAIDS:  Air Raids become active when you either ascend the ramp to to the upper level playfields or accept an active "Mission" by visiting the "HQ" kicker hole (providing no air raid is currently active). Air Raids are timed and when the raid is over all targets are reset. Time extensions are awarded when accepting missions or by completing "Patrol" loops. HQ is effectively closed during Air Raids and no awards are presented.

AMMUNITION: A full load of ammo is 250 rounds. Each flipper press while Air Raid is active discharges 5 rounds of ammo. Each ball starts with 100 rounds. Ammunition is reloaded at either of two Reload kicker holes. Ammunition counter is located between the flippers.

AAA: Anti-Aircraft Artillery can be fired by hitting the red targets on either side of the main playfield. An Air Raid must be active (yellow light flashing) and the AAA must be loaded. To load the AAA the yellow drop targets next to the fire button must be dropped. Each drop target gives one random hit to the plane targets on the upper level playfields. The drop targets reset 30 seconds after being hit. Kills can be achieved by using AAA if you're lucky.

Scoring:
---------

KILLS: Completing relevent targets on upper level playfields. Kill Markings are recorded on the Apron Surface.
Fighters = 1,000 (5,000 during Fighter mission)
Bombers = 3,000 (15,000 during Bomber mission)

BONUS: Every damage point or plane target hit lights a Bonus light up to a value of 99.
Bonus = 100 (x Bonus Multiplier)

BONUS MULTIPLIER: Advanced by completing F, I, R, E, inlane/outlane lights or the "Recon" lane lights once Recon mission is complete. One Extra Ball is awarded after the maximum 6x bonus has been realised.

Missions:
----------

RECON: Complete top left lane lights = 2,000. Subsequent completions increase the bonus multiplier. Lane changing via the flippers occurs after 20 bumper hits. Recon can not be completed twice in one ball.

PATROL: Complete all lights on the Patrol loop = 2,500. Patrol loop scores 1,000 thereafter. Each successful loop up until Patrol mission is complete adds 5 seconds to Air Raid time.

481677.overview: Bally's Bugs Bunny table was released in 1991 as part of the popular Looney Tunes character's 50th anniversary celebrations. Balutito has given it a little bit of extra "wrapping paper" in this reskin for Visual Pinball X.

481707.overview: Released in April 2022, Miguel Roche's "The Batman" for Visual Pinball X is a complete aesthetic overhaul and thematic redesign of the physical "Batman The Dark Knight" pinball machine originally released by Stern Pinball in 2008. It adapts the mechanics of the original machine to embody the gritty, atmospheric noir tone of Matt Reeves’ 2022 film The Batman, centering around Robert Pattinson’s portrayal of the Caped Crusader instead of Christian Bale's.

482098.overview: A Future Pinball version of Blackout (Williams, 1980) that adds Back in Black by AC/DC as in-game music and a more modern-style DMD.

482152.overview:
This Future Pinball version of Bounty Hunter (Gottlieb, 1985) replaces the electronic beeps of the original with Western-themed audio callouts and the music from the 1966 movie The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly.

So far so good, but unfortunately, it doesn't play very well: greedy outlanes result in too-frequent ball drains, the repetitive sound effects get annoying quickly, and the table awards much lower scores than the physical machine's original rom did. Digital pinball players are likely to have a better time playing a more authentic recreation in Visual Pinball X than this mod for Future Pinball.
